title: Alexa, Google, Siri: What are Your Pronouns? Gender and Anthropomorphism in the Design and Perception of Conversational Assistants
findings: The paper does not investigate or report any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on gender and anthropomorphism in conversational assistants. The only tangentially related reference is to a book titled 'Faces in the clouds: A new theory of religion', cited in the context of the psychological tendency for humans to personify non-human entities.
